voice.title: How I communicate
voice.subtitle: Who you talk to, in which tone, on which networks.

empty.title: Not filled in yet
empty.body: This is where we settle, once and for all, who you talk to, what you have to say and in which tone. Every calendar then uses it instead of starting from scratch.

plans.title: My calendar
plans.subtitle: What you will post, and on which day. You can prepare several — nothing gets erased.

empty.title: Nothing planned yet
empty.body: Pick a period and IDEM prepares everything you will have to post. December can be prepared as early as October.

plans.clickHint: Click a post to see it in full and edit it.

when.question: For which period?
when.help: Pick a length. You can always adjust the dates afterwards.

why.question: What do you want to get out of it?
why.help: One sentence, in your own words. It will guide everything else.
why.placeholder: For instance: make my shop known to families in the neighbourhood

known.label: Get known
known.text: Make my business known to new people near me

sell.label: Sell more
sell.text: Bring in more customers and sell more this month

loyal.label: Keep my customers
loyal.text: Stay present with my current customers and make them want to come back

hire.label: Hire
hire.text: Find someone to join my team

where.question: Where do you publish, and how often?
where.help: Pick your networks. Two networks kept well beat five left empty.

recap.question: Let's recap
recap.occasionsNone: No particular date in this period.
recap.occasionsHint: They will be woven into the posts, on the right day.
recap.price: 15 credits. You can change everything afterwards.

detail.noCaption: No text yet. Click Edit to write it.

detail.ctaPlaceholder: Come and see us, Call us…
detail.deleteAsk: Remove this post? The visual already created stays in “My visuals”.
detail.videoDone: A video was created for this post.

preview.menuLabel: What to do with this element

empty.title: What do you have to announce?

studio.caption: The post text

studio.chatHint: Here, ask for a change in a few words: “simpler”, “bigger price”…

simpler.label: Simpler

caption.label: The post text

library.title: My visuals
library.subtitle: Everything created on this project, wherever it came from.

empty.title: No visual yet
empty.body: Create one in 3 questions, or prepare your calendar and create the visuals of its posts.

library.publishHint: The text is copied and the network opens: all that is left is to paste and publish.
library.publishNeedsSchedule: Add this visual to a calendar first to be able to publish it.

thumb.failed: The image could not be displayed.

composing.title: Composing your visual
composing.patience: This takes 30 seconds to 2 minutes. You can wait here.

strategyInputs.heading: Your way of communicating is derived from two deliverables
strategyInputs.subtitle: It cannot be made up: the business plan states what you sell and to whom, the financial forecast gives your prices and your means. Without them the strategy would describe a brand, not your business — and everything that follows, plans and visuals, would inherit that mistake.
strategyInputs.illustrationAlt: Two deliverables feed the brand compass; without them the needle has no direction.

businessPlan.label: Business plan
businessPlan.effect: It provides the positioning, the market and the competition — enough to ground an angle that truly sets you apart.

finance.label: Financial forecast
finance.effect: It provides your prices and your communication budget — enough to propose channels you can actually fund.

voice.title: Start by saying who you are
voice.body: IDEM needs to know who you talk to and in which tone. You do it only once: the calendar, the visuals and the texts then draw on it.

plan.title: Prepare your posting calendar
plan.body: Pick a period, next month for instance. IDEM plans every post: the topic, the day, the network and the text to publish.

visuals.title: Create the visuals for your posts
visuals.body: {{count}} post(s) still need their image. Open one in your calendar: one click and the visual comes out in your colours.

publish.title: Publish on your networks
publish.body: Your posts are ready. Open one: the text is copied and the network opens, all that's left is to paste.

allDone.title: Everything is up to date
allDone.body: Every post in your calendar is online. Prepare the next period to keep the pace.

home.quickVisualLink: Just need a visual? Create it now
home.journeyHelp: Follow them in order the first time. You can come back to any of them at any time.

voice.title: Say who you are
voice.why: Who you talk to, in which tone, on which networks. Done only once.

plan.title: Prepare your calendar
plan.why: IDEM plans what to post and on which day, for the period you choose.

visuals.title: Create your visuals
visuals.why: An image with your colours and logo for every post in the calendar.

publish.title: Publish
publish.why: The text is ready: copy it, paste it on your network, it's online.

quick.title: A visual, right now
quick.body: No calendar needed for a one-off announcement: answer 3 questions, the visual comes out in your colours.

upcoming.title: Coming up
upcoming.empty: Nothing planned yet. Your calendar will tell you what to post every day.

what.question: What do you want to announce?
what.help: Pick the closest one. You will add the details right after.

announce.label: An announcement
announce.placeholder: E.g. from November 1st we are also open on Saturdays, 9am to 2pm.

promotion.label: A promotion
promotion.placeholder: E.g. 20% off all fabrics until October 15th, Cocody shop.

product.label: A product or service
product.placeholder: E.g. our new 100% natural hibiscus juice, 500 CFA francs a bottle.
product.prompt: present a product or a service

event.label: An event
event.placeholder: E.g. open day on Saturday October 12th, 10am to 6pm, free tasting.

celebration.label: Holiday wishes
celebration.placeholder: E.g. wish our customers a happy Independence Day.
celebration.prompt: send holiday wishes to our customers

recruitment.label: I'm hiring
recruitment.placeholder: E.g. we are hiring a full-time salesperson in Dakar, CV via WhatsApp.

other.label: Something else
other.placeholder: Describe what the visual should say.

details.question: What should the visual say?
details.help: Write it as you would tell a customer. IDEM takes care of the layout.

where.question: Where will you publish it?
where.help: This decides the shape of the image. You can get it in another format afterwards.

square.label: Post
square.prompt: in square format, for an Instagram or Facebook post

story.label: Story or status
story.prompt: in vertical story format, for a WhatsApp status or a story

banner.label: Banner
banner.prompt: in wide banner format, for a cover or a website

a4.label: Printed poster
a4.hint: A4 format, for the shop or the street

variants.label: Show me 3 different versions
variants.hint: To pick the one you prefer — 5 credits instead of 2.

prompt.details: Here is what it should say: {{details}}

steps.1: Pick a period: IDEM plans your posts day by day, with the text ready to publish.
steps.2: Click a post to read it, edit it and create its visual in one click.
steps.3: On the day, open it and publish: the text is copied, the network opens.

steps.1: Click a visual to see it full size.
steps.2: Download it, or get it in another format (story, banner…).
steps.3: Publish it: the text is copied and the network opens, all that's left is to paste.

list.title: My videos

what.question: What do you want people to know?
what.help: Pick what is closest to your message.

details.question: Say it in your own words
details.help: One sentence is enough. IDEM writes the on-screen text, picks the animations and the music.
details.morePlaceholder: Price, previous price, date, address, WhatsApp number, what makes you different…

tips.exact: Prices, dates and numbers are copied as written, never invented
tips.contact: Add your number or website for the call to action
tips.photos: Your own photos make the video far more convincing

photos.label: Your photos (optional)
photos.hint: Product, shop, team: up to 6 photos. Without photos, IDEM uses those of your visuals.

scope.question: Choose the scope
scope.help: Duration, formats and quality set the price. The first MP4 export is included.

price.reference: Benchmark: 15 s, one format, HD = {{price}} credits (twice the brand charter).

builder.creatingHint: IDEM writes the text, picks the music and syncs the animation to the beat. Allow 10 to 40 seconds.

type.question: What kind of video do you want?
type.help: Pick the motion style: the rest adapts.

media.label: Your media (optional)
media.hint: Photos, clips, a 3D model (.glb) or a Lottie animation (.json): IDEM places them in the right scenes. Up to 8 files.
media.stock: Search Pexels for photos and clips if needed
media.stockHint: Free library: the author is credited.
media.generate: Generate a clip if nothing fits
media.generateHint: With Gemini Veo, one clip per video, as a last resort.

sfx.label: Sound effects
sfx.hint: Whoosh on transitions, pop when a price appears, shimmer on the logo.

chat.question: Describe the video you want
chat.help: In your own words, as you would to an editor. IDEM picks the video type, or combines several (3D, clips, typography, animation), based on your request.
chat.placeholder: E.g.: a video announcing our new hibiscus juice at 1,000 F, with the bottle in 3D, that makes people order on WhatsApp.
chat.attachHint: Photos, videos, 3D model (.glb), Lottie or Rive animation: up to 8 files.

examples.ex1: Announce our end-of-year sale: 30% off the whole shop until December 31.
examples.ex2: Present our new product in 3D, with three benefits and a call to order.
examples.ex3: Invite our customers to the opening of our second shop, with the date and address.

chat.autoType: Video type: chosen by IDEM from your request
